section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical testing of a hypothesized structural model with 249 participants using Mplus Version 4.1 and maximum likelihood estimation. The analysis examined relationships among variables including restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, depressive symptoms, body appreciation, and intuitive eating, with BMI controlled for in the model. The final revised model demonstrated good fit indices (CFI=.99, SRMR=.04, RMSEA=.03) and revealed that body appreciation was predicted by multiple factors and in turn predicted intuitive eating.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analysis of a structural equation model examining relationships among caregiver eating messages, attachment styles, perfectionism, body appreciation, depressive symptoms, and intuitive eating in a single study with 249 participants. The analysis controlled for BMI and tested model fit using multiple indices (CFI, SRMR, RMSEA), ultimately retaining a revised model that accounted for substantial variance in body appreciation (40.5%) and intuitive eating (44.4%).
